why_notable: One of Long Island's pioneering wineries, Wölffer Estate is renowned for producing high-quality Merlot that competes with premium East Coast wines.
Dr. Konstantin Frank revolutionized Finger Lakes winemaking by proving Riesling could thrive in New York's climate, establishing the region's signature varietal.
Hermann J. Wiemer is a legendary Finger Lakes pioneer whose balanced, elegant dry Rieslings set the standard for New York's cool-climate white wines.
Red Newt Cellars has established itself as a quality producer of Pinot Noir in the Finger Lakes, demonstrating the region's capability for premium red wines.
Barboursville is Virginia's pioneering winery, internationally recognized for its elegant Cabernet Franc and role in establishing Virginia's wine reputation.
RdV Vineyards produces age-worthy, Bordeaux-style Cabernet Sauvignon that ranks among Virginia's most critically acclaimed and collectible wines.
Early Mountain Vineyards is known for producing sophisticated Bordeaux blends that demonstrate Virginia's potential for world-class red wine production.
King Family Vineyards is a prominent Virginia producer known for elegant, well-balanced Cabernet Sauvignon and consistent quality across its portfolio.
Becker Vineyards is one of Texas's oldest and most respected wineries, producing high-quality Cabernet Sauvignon that helped establish Hill Country's wine reputation.
William Chris Vineyards is a premier Texas producer known for refined Bordeaux blends and commitment to sustainable farming practices in Hill Country.
Chateau Grand Traverse is Michigan's largest winery and a pioneer of quality wine production on the Old Mission Peninsula, particularly known for Pinot Noir.
Left Foot Charley is a respected Michigan winery known for producing crisp, well-crafted Pinot Gris and innovative wines from Old Mission Peninsula fruit.
A to Z Wineworks produces accessible, high-quality Pinot Noir from Oregon's renowned Willamette Valley, known for consistent excellence and value.
Charles Smith Wines is known for producing distinctive, high-quality Riesling that showcases Washington state's ability to compete in cool-climate white wine production.
Chrysalis Vineyards is recognized as a leader in producing exceptional Norton, Virginia's state grape, demonstrating the varietal's potential for world-class wines.
